evidence_form: Normalized transcription of connector responses; not raw XML, raw HTML, or a full analytics export

visible_queries.limitation: Visible queries are not the full query population. Their totals do not reconcile to property totals; do not infer a complete branded/non-branded split.

selected_page_metrics.selection: Buyer, evidence, documentation and variant URLs; not all 58 rows are copied here
selected_page_metrics.limitation: Page impressions can overlap at property level. Do not sum them into distinct searches or use zero clicks as retirement authority.

sitemap.field_interpretation: 51 exact URL strings matched positive impressions, not 51 URLs proven indexed by URL Inspection

homepage_join.interpretation: Likely exact-string join mismatch; not evidence that the homepage lost indexing. Preserve raw strings and reconcile before changing canonicals.

sitemap.limitation: An empty submitted-sitemap list does not mean no sitemap file. No sitemap was submitted or changed. Missing page performance is not an indexing verdict.

prior_url_inspections.limitation: Stored Google snapshots for five URLs, not whole-site current coverage. The earlier inspections stored diagnostic history but did not request indexing.

prior_onpage_audit.limitation: Automated title-length and missing-schema/logo labels are heuristics, not established ranking blockers. Validate schema applicability before treating a label as a required repair. This audit is not a rendered accessibility or performance test.

open_measurement_gaps: GSC Wizard Core Web Vitals call returned notConfigured: no CrUX API key; no performance pass, fail or insufficient-traffic conclusion.
GA4 was not connected through GSC Wizard in the earlier baseline; qualified-enquiry conversion rate is unknown, not zero.
GSC Wizard indexing tracker was not configured in the earlier baseline; this says nothing about Google's total index coverage.
The live homepage content fetch and earlier on-page audit expose differing metadata strings. Reconcile raw HTML, title templates and rendered metadata before a metadata repair.
No deployment-specific source identity, comprehensive HTTP redirect chain, backlink graph or full locale parity was established.

keyword_opportunities.observed: The earlier score_opportunities call returned only firstverifier, 15 impressions, zero clicks, average position about 6.93.
keyword_opportunities.not_a_forecast: Its four potential clicks used a generic CTR heuristic, not validated buyer demand or guaranteed growth.
hypotheses_only: AI agent tools and access review
keyword_opportunities.rule: Validate buyer intent and query-to-page fit before content investment; no branded or non-branded growth claim from this small sample.
